english.note: Use this for the usual Hong Kong title of a government minister who heads a bureau.

exampleSentences.english: The minister will explain the new policy to the Legislative Council tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 局長聽日會向立法會交代新政策。

english.note: Use this for the head of a government bureau or department, rather than for a clerical secretary.

exampleSentences.english: The secretary went to the Legislative Council for a meeting today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 局長今日去立法會開會。
